title: Extremum Seeking with Double Integrators in the Presence of Local Extrema
summary: We study the problem of global extremum seeking in the presence of local extrema. We investigate two different perturbation-based methods: 1) a well-known classical extremum seeking scheme for steady-state output optimization, and 2) a source seeking scheme for a two-dimensional point mass. In each of these two scenarios, the closed-loop system involves a damped double integrator subject to an oscillatory force.
